name: Pioni
source:
Witch class.
A fun-loving girl who loves to play pranks with her twin sister Vivi, another student in the witch class.
Student or professor, nobody is safe from the twins' mischief.
Sometimes they get scolded for taking their pranks too far, but since Pioni doesn't think they did anything wrong, she'll already be thinking about what they're going to do next.
